home.h1: Free Online MOV to MP4 Converter
home.heroSubtitle: Convert iPhone and QuickTime MOV videos to universally compatible MP4 directly in your browser — fast, lossless, and 100% private with no file uploads.
home.stepsHeading: How to Convert MOV to MP4 Online in 3 Steps
home.stepsIntro: Switching a QuickTime video into a standard MP4 takes just a few clicks and never leaves your computer or phone.
home.step1Body: Drag one or multiple .mov files from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac into the converter box above, or click Select MOV Files to browse your device.
home.step2Body: Keep Original settings for instant lossless container remuxing, or open a clip's options to trim start and end timestamps, mute audio, or scale to 1080p, 720p, or 480p.
home.step3Body: Click Convert to MP4 to process everything locally via WebAssembly, then save each finished MP4 individually or download the entire batch together.
home.engineHeading: Instant Browser Conversion (No Uploads or 1 GB Caps)
home.engineLead: Traditional online converters force you to upload huge QuickTime recordings to a remote server, wait in a queue, and hit strict 500 MB or 1 GB limits. This converter runs an isolated FFmpeg engine right inside your browser tab.
home.engineCard1Body: Most modern iPhone and QuickTime MOV files already contain H.264 or HEVC video. When you don't trim or resize, the tool re-wraps the existing streams into an MP4 container (-c copy) in roughly one second with zero generation loss.
home.engineCard2Body: Need to trim a screen recording, lower resolution for faster sharing, or convert Apple ProRes footage? The engine automatically encodes clean H.264 video and AAC audio for broad compatibility.
home.engineCard3Body: Because processing happens inside your browser memory, personal family clips, client footage, and sensitive screen recordings never touch an external server—and there are no artificial 1 GB upload walls.
home.controlsLead: Fine-tune multiple clips at once without opening a heavy desktop video editor.
home.control1Body: Add several MOV files at once, review file sizes, adjust settings per clip or convert the whole queue sequentially with live per-file progress bars.
home.control2Body: Type simple MM:SS timestamps to cut away dead air at the beginning or end of an iPhone screen recording before saving the MP4.
home.control3Body: Strip background mic noise cleanly with Mute Audio or downscale 4K footage to 1080p, 720p, or 480p for smaller email and chat attachments.
home.playbackHeading: Universal Playback Across Windows, Android & Web
home.playbackLead: While Apple devices handle .mov natively, many Windows, Android, and web workflows stumble on QuickTime containers or ProRes codecs.
home.playback1Body: Convert Mac MOV exports into standard H.264 MP4 files so colleagues on Windows 10 and Windows 11 can open them immediately without extra codec packs.
home.playback2Body: Avoid broken inline previews on Discord, WhatsApp, and Android phones by repackaging or downscaling clips into clean, web-ready MP4s.
home.playback3Body: Standardized MP4 files with fast-start metadata play reliably inside PowerPoint, Google Slides, Notion, and HTML5 video players.
home.faqHeading: Frequently Asked Questions About MOV to MP4 Conversion
home.faq1Q: Are my MOV videos uploaded to any server?
home.faq1A: No. Your videos stay strictly on your own device. The converter loads a single-threaded WebAssembly build of FFmpeg inside your browser and writes the output MP4 locally in memory.
home.faq2Q: Why does standard conversion finish in around a second without losing quality?
home.faq2A: When your MOV uses H.264 or HEVC and you keep the original resolution and audio without trimming, the tool performs a smart container remux (-c copy). It copies the exact video and audio frames into an MP4 wrapper without re-encoding.
home.faq3Q: Can I convert large MOV files over 1 GB?
home.faq3A: Yes, there are no server upload caps or 1 GB paywalls. Conversion size is limited only by the RAM available to your browser tab, and fast remuxing uses far less memory and time than full re-encoding.
home.faq4Q: What happens when I trim, mute audio, change resolution, or convert ProRes MOV files?
home.faq4A: If you set Trim timestamps, change resolution (1080p, 720p, or 480p), or drop a ProRes or incompatible codec, the engine automatically switches to fast H.264/AAC encoding so the resulting MP4 plays everywhere.
home.faq5Q: Does it work on Windows, Mac, iPhone, and Android?
home.faq5A: Yes. Any modern browser with WebAssembly support—including Chrome, Edge, Safari, and Firefox on desktop or mobile—can convert MOV files to MP4 offline once loaded.

howToUse.h1: How to Use MOV to MP4 Converter
howToUse.intro: A straightforward guide to turning QuickTime, iPhone, and Mac .mov videos into clean, universally playable .mp4 files directly in your web browser.
howToUse.step1Heading: Step 1: Add One or Multiple MOV Files
howToUse.step1Body: Open the converter on the home page and drop your .mov files into the focal dropzone—or tap Select MOV Files. You can queue a single iPhone screen recording or batch-add multiple QuickTime clips together.
howToUse.step2Heading: Step 2: Choose Lossless Remux or Custom Options
howToUse.step2Body: Leave Quality / Resolution on Original for a near-instant container remux (-c copy) that preserves 100% of your original video and audio quality. Expand Trim, Audio & Resolution if you want to cut Start/End MM:SS timestamps, mute microphone audio, or resize to 1080p, 720p, or 480p.
howToUse.step3Heading: Step 3: Convert Locally and Save MP4
howToUse.step3Body: Press Convert to MP4 (or Convert All to MP4 for batches). On your first conversion, the browser lazily downloads the single-threaded FFmpeg core once, then processes every frame privately on your own hardware before giving you instant Download MP4 buttons.
howToUse.useCase1Body: Turn iOS screen recordings and HEVC/H.264 camera .mov files into .mp4 so they play smoothly on PCs and upload cleanly everywhere.
howToUse.useCase2Body: Downscale high-bitrate clips to 720p or 480p and mute unwanted background audio before sending in chat.
howToUse.useCase3Body: Convert Mac QuickTime exports—including Apple ProRes clips—into standard H.264/AAC MP4 files compatible with Windows and Android players.
